question_text: Compare the average head_count at KeynoteHall_Stage between the morning keynote window 09:00-10:00 UTC and the afternoon keynote window 14:00-15:00 UTC on 2025-12-08. Which keynote had higher attendance and what were the approximate average head_counts?
answer_text: The morning keynote at KeynoteHall_Stage had higher attendance with an average head_count of approximately 450.19, compared to the afternoon keynote, which had an average head_count of approximately 399.51.

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(:Camera {camera_location: 'KeynoteHall_Stage'})
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T09:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T10:00:00Z'
WITH ch.avg_hc AS morning_avg_hc
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(:Camera {camera_location: 'KeynoteHall_Stage'})
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T14:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T15:00:00Z'
RETURN morning_avg_hc, ch.avg_hc AS afternoon_avg_hc, 
       CASE WHEN morning_avg_hc > ch.avg_hc THEN 'Morning' ELSE 'Afternoon' END AS higher_attendance_keynote
